scope: rrrah-dedup cache stream write interruption and cancellation
before_fix: Bounded reproducer failed at byte0 with Io(Other): standard write_all retried interruptions without cancellation.
fix: Internal write loop retries Interrupted and checks cancellation after each interruption, preserving existing ordinary write checkpoints. Other errors propagate and zero write reports WriteZero.
limits: Synthetic Write control, no real OS signal injection.
A blocking Write implementation still requires its own timeout or interruption.
Partial stream is permitted on write failure; atomic save remains required for destination preservation.
Full all-case objective and remaining repository reviews not complete.
